Key Requirements:
This standard deals with revenue recognition and
establishes principles for reporting useful information
to users of financial statements about the the nature,
amount, timing and uncertainty of revenue and cash
flows arising from an entity’s contracts with customers.
Revenue is recognised when a customer obtains control
of a good or service and thus has the ability to direct the
use and obtain the benefits from the good or service. The
new standard replaces IAS 11 and IAS 18.
